description: For a family of first-order structures and an ultrafilter \(\mathcal U\), coordinatewise functions and relations true on a set in \(\mathcal U\) respect equality of representative functions on a set in \(\mathcal U\), at every finite arity, including zero.
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.Ultraproduct.setoidPrestructure.{u, v, u_1, u_2} {α : Type u_1} (M : α → Type u_2)
  (u : Ultrafilter α) {L : FirstOrder.Language} [(a : α) → L.Structure (M a)] : L.Prestructure ((↑u).productSetoid M)
